requirements.title: Milestone boundary and invariant
requirements.summary: Business Suit ecosystem integration. Synthetic-only implementation; retain doctor ownership, independent secretary grants and separate patient identity/relationship/encounter; no clinical/legal/provider/commercial authority inferred.
requirements.provenance: Supplied roadmap v0.2 plus current delegated scope.

requirements.title: Ecosystem domain and sharing contract
requirements.summary: Confirm what Business Suit means and each existing Suit owner; preserve clinical boundaries and capability-based integration. Acceptance: Resolve what Business Suit means using named existing product owners and verified capability/version contracts; do not create a fictional shared platform. Approve purpose-specific minimum data/event fields, authentication, revocation and reconciliation responsibilities per integration. Preserve independent product Auth, clinical chart boundaries and data ownership; no shared patient tables, contact-based account linking or cross-product SSO. Prepare evidence for DOS-M8-GATE-ECOSYSTEM. Stop before any provider/native/live-data dependent implementation until the accountable reviewer approves the relevant decision; producing this packet does not grant approval.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-001 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Versioned events and durable outbox/inbox
requirements.summary: Implement authenticated event contracts, idempotency, replay and failure handling without shared clinical tables. Acceptance: Define versioned event envelopes with tenant/product provenance, stable event/idempotency IDs, minimal payload and authenticated sender/audience. Implement transactional outbox and receiver inbox deduplication with bounded retry, dead-letter/reconciliation and ordered/version-aware handling where required. Enforce per-integration capability and revocation on dispatch/receive; independent services never bypass product authorization through events.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-002 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Accounting/Ledger integration
requirements.summary: Export minimized financial facts with reconciliation; exclude diagnoses, prescriptions and clinical notes by default. Acceptance: Verify the actual Ledger ingestion contract and approve financial field mapping, currencies, source IDs and reconciliation responsibility. Export minimized approved financial facts only; diagnoses, prescriptions, patient notes and unnecessary identifiers are excluded by default. Use authenticated versioned idempotent exchange with explicit pending/rejected/reconciled state; no direct writes into Ledger tables or reuse of its sessions/secrets.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-003 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Inventory and consumables integration
requirements.summary: Connect approved usage/stock references only when the owning Inventory/Shop capability is verified. Acceptance: Verify the owning Inventory/Shop capability for approved consumable usage/reference flows and its contract version. Map only authorized stock/usage facts and explicit source documents; this task cannot infer medication substitution or dispensing authority. Keep stock owner as authoritative and reconcile accepted/rejected/pending usage; no cross-app imports or direct shared database writes.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-004 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Team/employment reference integration
requirements.summary: Link approved staff references without granting payroll/HR users access to patient records. Acceptance: Approve staff-reference fields and the actual owning employment/team capability; employment identity is distinct from Doctor membership. Link only explicit verified references and keep clinical access governed by Doctor grants; HR/payroll status never grants chart rights. Handle reference revocation, renaming and stale external identity without deleting internal audit or silently merging accounts.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-005 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Notification/mail capability integration
requirements.summary: Use approved consented communication routing with minimal payloads and no cross-product session reuse. Acceptance: Verify an existing approved notification/mail capability and route only consented purpose-specific minimal templates. Preserve per-product sender authorization, independent sessions and outbox idempotency; receiving capability cannot read charts to construct messages. Recheck consent and recipient scope at send time and reconcile delivery/cancellation/unknown outcomes under the approved provider policy.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-006 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Aggregated reporting and consent-aware sharing
requirements.summary: Expose authorized minimized aggregates; do not repurpose treatment data for marketing. Acceptance: Define approved aggregate measures, disclosure scope and suppression rules with accountable privacy review; do not invent a safe anonymity threshold. Generate minimized aggregates from authorized populations with provenance and consent/use constraints; treatment data is not repurposed for marketing. Prevent drill-through or small-group disclosure beyond approved policy and revoke access when integration authority changes.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-007 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

requirements.title: Cross-Suit contract and failure acceptance
requirements.summary: Test outages, replay, revocation and reconciliation across independently authorized products. Acceptance: Test each selected integration against verified partner contract/version and exact Doctor candidate with independent product-owner acceptance. Demonstrate replay, outage, revocation, schema incompatibility, source correction and financial/stock/message reconciliation. Unselected or unavailable integrations stay disabled and are excluded from claims; no optional provider or cross-Suit release is automatic.
requirements.provenance: Detailed decomposition of DOS-M8-008 from supplied roadmap; ordinary design choices, evidence-gated domain decisions.

decisions.title: DOS-M8 parent-controlled start gate
decisions.decision_text: Remain OPEN until all nine milestones are safely stored and parent verifies dependency acceptance, exact live runtime/registration/commands/paths and authorizes this milestone. Import does not grant execution.

decisions.title: Named Business Suit domain owners, capability and disclosure agreements
decisions.decision_text: Evidence from DOS-M8-001 must identify the accountable reviewer, approved scope/version and constraints. Missing evidence stays OPEN. A worker cannot approve this on behalf of a reviewer.

transaction_contract: Verify exact Automation target, live function/schema/trigger fingerprints, immutable project ID, route, model, retry policy, command registrations and publication scopes before writes.

Acquire parent-reviewed transaction serialization lock and reread every scoped ID; existing equal payload is a no-op only after full canonical comparison; any differing state/history aborts. Never overwrite existing tasks, decisions, execution or requirement history.
Create or verify the real OPEN milestone start decision before any task; create every task through supported function and link every task to that decision with blocking=true in the SAME transaction.
Create all requirement, decision and dependency links and refresh contracts after final metadata. Do not commit partial task/link batches.

Assert exact payload counts, complete links, zero ready Doctor tasks using live ready-task predicate, zero claims/runs/executions, no publication authority, and all start decisions still OPEN immediately before commit.
Dry-run rollback and review returned evidence first. Parent controls any commit; never remove a guard from the original draft SQL.
After commit read back canonical packets and zero-ready evidence. Keep all nine start gates open until parent confirms all nine safely saved; release each milestone separately in dependency order.
